notes: Missing foreign private members throw directly, bypassing business noSuchMethod, matching pinned CFE behavior.

Generated contracts obtain native Invocation data from genuine CFE noSuchMethod forwarders. Public fail entry points keep helper private selectors inside their declaring library across bytecode modules.
Original concrete inheritance, same-library implementations, part ownership and duplicate private names across libraries retain their behavior.
Patch-first implementations can add helper classes; removing the obligation can retire only unused generated helpers. User class deletion remains prohibited.
The initial public Invocation prototype matched exception types but not native error text; that failed comparison was preserved and the implementation replaced before final validation.
Historical full native suite was not rerun; this report covers fourteen rebuilt groups.
limitations: Full Flutter and mobile cold start, signing/rollback and physical-device performance remain incomplete.
Covariant declarations and broader language combinations are not accepted by these fixtures. Failing-path helper allocations are not benchmarked.
